description.value: The study investigated whether early language experience influences later neural processing during a French phonological working memory task using fMRI in French monolingual, Chinese–French bilingual, and internationally adopted children.

spans.text: Using fMRI, we scanned the following three groups performing a French phonological working memory (PWM) task: (1) monolingual French children; (2) children adopted from China before age 3 who discontinued Chinese and spoke only French; (3) Chinese-speaking children who learned French as a second language but maintained Chinese.

description.value: Observational, cross-sectional study of three participant groups performing a French phonological working memory task during fMRI; participants were not assigned to interventions and experimenters were not blind to group membership.
